beacons.name: CKM row-1 unitarity
beacons.note: Sum |V_ud|^2 + |V_us|^2 + |V_ub|^2 for the CKM matrix's first row must equal 1 (tolerance 0.01% = ppm-scale).

beacons.name: Framework dm2_21 vs NuFIT anchor
beacons.reference: NuFIT file (5.2-era values; see dataset metadata)
beacons.note: Registered neutrino.dm2_21 (LIVE) vs the NuFIT dataset anchor.

beacons.name: Framework |dm2_32| vs NuFIT IO anchor
beacons.note: Registered neutrino.dm2_32 magnitude (LIVE) vs the dataset IO anchor 2.498e-3 eV²; the ~3.8% gap is the known 3.35σ tension.

beacons.name: E8 Freudenthal dimension identity
beacons.reference: Kac (1990) Infinite-Dimensional Lie Algebras, Ch. 6; Serre
beacons.note: dim(E8) = 240 non-zero roots + 8 Cartan generators = 248 (integer exact).

beacons.name: alpha_em Thomson-vs-M_Z running ratio
beacons.reference: Peskin-Schroeder, Introduction to QFT, Ch. 10; PDG 2024
beacons.note: Ratio alpha_em(0) / alpha_em(M_Z) ~ 1.071 is a QED-running consistency check.

beacons.name: Jarlskog invariant vs Wolfenstein parameterisation
beacons.note: PDG J_CP compared to Wolfenstein J = A^2 * eta * lambda^6; tolerance 5% matches PDG uncertainty on eta.

beacons.name: G2 spinor bundle dimension identity
beacons.reference: Salamon (1989) Riemannian Geometry and Holonomy Groups; Atiyah-Segal
beacons.note: dim(Cl(7)) = 2^7 = 128; irreducible spinor rep dim = 8 (integer exact).

beacons.name: G2 fundamental representation dimension via Weyl formula
beacons.reference: Fulton-Harris (1991) Representation Theory: A First Course, Ch. 22
beacons.note: G2 fundamental irrep has dim = 7 by the Weyl character/dimension formula.

beacons.name: PMNS row-1 unitarity (LIVE framework angles)
beacons.note: cos²θ13 + sin²θ13 must be exactly 1 for any consistent (θ12, θ13) pair.

beacons.name: G_F-M_W-sin2thetaW tree-level identity (LIVE)
beacons.note: G_F vs πα/(√2·M_W²·sin²θ_W) from the registered gauge block; tree-level identity holds to ~4% (Δr radiative corrections).

beacons.name: Friedmann closure Omega_m + Omega_Lambda + Omega_r ~ 1 (LIVE)
beacons.note: Registered density parameters must close to 1 for the flat background the modules assume. NOTE: geometry.Omega_Lambda is the clamped 0.70 anchor (see geometric_anchors audit) — with Planck Omega_m = 0.315 the sum runs ~1.5% hot; tolerance set to flag anything beyond that known offset.

beacons.name: hbar*c = 197.327 MeV.fm chain (LIVE)
beacons.note: Registered hbar (GeV.s) x c, converted to MeV.fm — pure unit-chain check.

note: Textbook consistency beacons: cross-checks against standard physics references. NOT predictions of the Principia Metaphysica model — these are independent identities the framework should satisfy to be consistent with the textbooks. Failures here indicate a drift bug, not a novel prediction.
